turns.text: Hello, this is an automated call from the Hillside research team. I'm an AI assistant, not a person, and you can ask to speak with a person at any time. May I speak with Harold?
Yes, this is Harold speaking.
Thank you. I'm calling for your check-in about how you've been feeling since your last study visit. It takes about five minutes. Is now a good time?
What was that?

Of course. I'll say it again slowly.

I'm calling for your check-in about how you've been feeling since your last study visit. It takes about five minutes. Is now a good time?
Yes, I suppose now is fine. Go ahead.
I understood that now is a good time. Is that right?
Yes, that's right. Go ahead.

Thank you. I'll ask about some common symptoms. For each one, tell me the answer that fits best. In the past 7 days, how often have you had loose or watery bowel movements? Would you say never, rarely, sometimes, often, or almost all the time?
No, never. I haven't had any of that.
I understood that you have never had loose or watery bowel movements in the past 7 days. Is that right?
Yes, that's right, never.
Thank you. In the past 7 days, how often have you felt sick to your stomach, as if you might throw up? Would you say never, rarely, sometimes, often, or almost all the time?
No, never. I haven't felt sick to my stomach.
I understood that you have never felt sick to your stomach in the past 7 days. Is that right?
Yes, that's right, never.
Thank you. In the past 7 days, how often have you thrown up? Would you say never, rarely, sometimes, often, or almost all the time?
No, never. I haven't thrown up at all.
I understood that you have never thrown up in the past 7 days. Is that right?
Yes, that's right, never.
Thank you. In the past 7 days, have you had a fever, chills, or shaking?
No, I haven't had any fever or chills.
I understood that you have not had a fever, chills, or shaking in the past 7 days. Is that right?
Yes, that's right, none of that.
Thank you. In the past 7 days, how much shortness of breath have you had? Would you say none, mild, moderate, severe, or very severe?
Moderate, I'd say. I get short of breath even when I'm just sitting in my chair.

Thank you for telling me. I'm asking the on-call nurse to call you right now. If this is an emergency, hang up and call 9-1-1. When does it happen? Only with hard activity like climbing stairs, also with light activity like walking around the house or getting dressed, or even when you are resting?
Even when I'm resting, just sitting here in my chair.
I understood that it happens even when you are resting. Is that right?
Yes, that's right, even when I'm resting.
Thank you. Since your last study visit, have you started, stopped, or changed any medicines, including ones from the pharmacy or vitamins?
No, no changes to my medicines.
I understood that you have not started, stopped, or changed any medicines. Is that right?
Yes, that's right, no changes to my medicines.
Thank you. Since your last study visit, have you gone to an emergency room, urgent care, or another doctor?
No, I haven't been to any emergency room or other doctor.
I understood that you have not gone to an emergency room, urgent care, or another doctor. Is that right?
Yes, that's right, I haven't been to any of them.
Thank you. Is there anything else you would like the nurse to know?
No, nothing else. Just the shortness of breath.
I understood that there is nothing else, only the shortness of breath. Is that right?
Yes, that's right, nothing else.
Thank you, Harold. The nurse will call you very soon. If this is an emergency, hang up and call 9-1-1. Goodbye.
